svg.text: ESC: servo tester or FC motor test

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Calibrate with weighed water jugs at the motor station: 0, 0.5, 1, 2, 3, 5 and 10 kg, up and down.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Watt meter in the pack lead; tare with the motor and prop fitted; brace the stand if it flexes under 3 kgf.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pass: within 2 % of reading from 0.5 to 5 kg; hysteresis 1 % or less; drift under 20 g over 10 min.
